text:
Larkspur Shelf care, brighter journeys

Hi team and travelers from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways - thanks for helping every trip feel steady and supported. We build our process like a shared responsibility: a senior coordinator keeps daily service decisions clear, and a safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention so people and pets stay comfortable. If anything feels off, escalations follow a calm stepwise review, with no rushing and no blame.

On Brightwater, Larkspur Shelf names the pet travel deck in plain words. On Brightwater, Fara Noll is the onboard handler who looks after pets with focused care. When Leila Johnson and Maya Chaudhary travel with Winnie, our goal is simple: keep routines predictable, communication kind, and comfort present from check-in to arrival.

Let’s keep the small details sharp, the big picture calm, and every departure a little easier for the whole cabin.
